hold_reason: review: Google: The Hindi definition uses 'दोषमुक्ति', which means 'acquittal'. In criminal law, discharge is 'उन्मोचन' (release without framing charges), distinct from acquittal.
objections: Google: The Hindi definition uses 'दोषमुक्ति', which means 'acquittal'. In criminal law, discharge is 'उन्मोचन' (release without framing charges), distinct from acquittal.
NVIDIA: Hindi meaning 'दोषमुक्ति' incorrectly equates discharge with acquittal; discharge is pre-charge release, not acquittal.
